newsitem.title: USA: Sterling group's options on Aztar expires.
newsitem.headline: Sterling group's options on Aztar expires.

text.p: A group led by Sterling Foster Holding Corp said Friday options that it held on Aztar Corp's stock had expired and it now holds only 1,080,700 common shares or a 2.4 percent stake in the company.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it now holds its investment in the company for passive purposes. In October when it held about six percent of Aztar, it had said it might seek to acquire the company.
Because of the option expirations, it said it will no longer seek state of New Jersey regulatory approval to become qualified holders of Aztar securities.
The group's latest tranactions include a net 151,800 common sold from November 4 to December 19 at prices ranging from $7 to $7.875 per share.
Aztar, based in Phoenix, Ar., operates casino hotels in major domestic gaming markets.
